name: Agenticsis Visibility Monitor
description: Agenticsis Visibility Monitor reports how your company currently appears in AI answers and organic search. Connect it and ask Claude: How often do ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews cite my brand for my tracked queries, and with what sentiment? What is my Share of Voice versus each competitor this month, and how is it trending? Where do my keywords rank, what do my backlink and traffic profiles look like, and which of the 54 checks in my AEO/SEO scorecard does my site pass or fail? What did the full-site technical crawl find, which entity signals (Wikidata, Crunchbase, schema consistency) is my Knowledge Panel readiness missing, and what does this week's market intelligence (fresh industry news, Perplexity research brief, real search volumes) say about my space? Every number is measured monthly by the Agenticsis pipeline from data sources Claude cannot query alone (DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Perplexity) and is scoped to your own company. Read-only measurement and reporting. Requires an active Agenticsis Visibility account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Agenticsis Visibility Monitor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Agenticsis Visibility Monitor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.agenticsis.ch/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Agenticsis Visibility Monitor MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agenticsis Visibility Monitor lists 17 MCP tools, including get_ai_citations, get_authority_records, get_backlinks, get_client_metrics, get_competitors, get_content_gap, get_full_site_audit, get_keyword_snapshot, get_knowledge_panel_readiness, get_live_intelligence, get_playbook_scorecard, and get_rankings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Agenticsis Visibility Monitor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Agenticsis Visibility Monitor in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Agenticsis Visibility Monitor MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agenticsis Visibility Monitor requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Agenticsis Visibility Monitor is developed by Agenticsis. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
